text:
Tess: Heads-up — legal just asked for access to historical chat embeddings for a subject rights request. The snapshots are in s3 and encrypted with an old KMS key that we rotated. They want a forensic export for evidence. Need checklist for granting temporary access without breaking retention/erasure promises.

Sam: Do we have a ticket? who requested and scope?

Tess: Ticket #SR-8412. Requester: legal@redwood. Scope: user id 12345, timeframe Jan–Mar 2024. Need full embedding vectors + original text for verification.

Mia: We can't provide original text unless legal gives explicit lawful basis. Also must consider minimization — can we provide redacted vectors? :thinking_face: 

Legal: Confirmed lawful basis; court subpoena included. We need forensics team to pull originals. Urgent.

Jordan: Technical notes — snapshots are encrypted with kms-key-2019, rotation created new key but old key still in KMS but scheduled for deletion? I see it in console: key state = Disabled. If disabled we can't decrypt.

Sam: If key is disabled we can re-enable via KMS but need breakglass justification and auditable approvals.

Mia: Process: 1) get signed legal attestation, 2) SRE changes no forking ACLs; create ephemeral role with least privilege, 3) require 2-person approval and time-limited expiration, 4) enable detailed audit logging and S3 access logs, 5) snapshot copy into a locked forensic bucket with restricted retention.

Tess: Can someone draft the IAM policy snippet and the KMS re-enable play?

Jordan: Quick IAM snippet I used recently:
```
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {"Effect":"Allow","Action":"s3:GetObject","Resource":"arn:aws:s3:::forensic-bucket/*"},
    {"Effect":"Allow","Action":"kms:Decrypt","Resource":"arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:acct:key/old-key-id"}
  ]
}
```

Mia: Add condition: aws:MultiFactorAuthPresent true and aws:RequestTag/forensic_ticket = SR-8412

OpsOncall: I'll stand by for approval window. Put me as approver in ticket.

AuditBot: audit log created: SR-8412 | requestor=legal@redwood | action=request_forensic_pull | ts=1716189023

Tess: We also need retention exception sign-off — Data Governance must sign because original retention policy is "delete after 30d". This is an exception.

Legal: I'll get the signed attestation and cc DG.

Mia: One more: we must record redaction decisions. If we can't provide original text, provide hashed snippets and provenance.

Sam: Timeline? Legal needs this by EOD tomorrow.

Jordan: Re-enable key requires KMS admin — I'll request breakglass approval from sec-leads. If key is ScheduledForDeletion, we can't recover past 30d. Need to check.

Tess: Action items: Jordan to check key state and feasibility; Mia to draft access policy and audit checklist; OpsOncall to be approver; Legal to provide signed attestation; Sam to coordinate extraction and ensure minimization. I'll update ticket.

Mia: Also add: export must be encrypted with new key and only stored in forensic-bucket for 90 days max, then moved to legal-hold if necessary.

Sam: ack. I'll add runbook steps and run dry run on staging S3 copy first.

Tess: Thanks — ping here when approvals done :thumbsup: 

AuditBot: SR-8412 status updated -> awaiting_approvals ts=1716189321

Jordan: Key state: old-key-id = Disabled, not scheduled for deletion. We can re-enable after approval. Confirmed.

OpsOncall: approval granted by ops-lead at 1716189600. I've added time window 4 hours.

Mia: Drafts uploaded to ticket: https://internal/redwood/tickets/SR-8412 — check.

Legal: Attestation attached. Proceed.

Tess: Starting extraction now, will report back when done.

AuditBot: forensic_export_completed SR-8412 | actor=Sam | ts=1716189755
